summary: HDFC Bank Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the conclusion of a previously initiated legal review into the resignation letter of former director Mr. Atanu Chakraborty. The review was conducted by external law firms Wilson Sonsini Goodrich Rosati and Wadia Ghandy over three months, involving document review and interviews. The firms found Mr. Chakraborty's statements were not substantiated. This is a governance event, not a special situation transaction.
